title: The crypto industry is bracing for a reckoning after Democrats won the US midterms and vowed to investigate the Trump family and its ties to the industry (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: The crypto industry is bracing for a reckoning after Democrats won the US midterms and vowed to investigate the Trump family and its ties to the industry — Democrats have vowed to start investigation into president's family after sweeping victory in midterms
